user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my best friend's birthday. Can you help me gather some information about her favorite Instagram users and their following? Also, find out if she has any Instagram stories or IGTV channels.

TaskList.description: Gather information about the user's favorite Instagram accounts.
Retrieve the follower count for each of the favorite Instagram accounts gathered in Step 1.
Check if the user has any active Instagram stories.
Check if the user has any IGTV channels or videos.
